azure.logging.managed_hsm_audit_destinat.description: Inspect enabled AuditEvent diagnostic settings with valid native Storage or Log Analytics resource references. Enabled category groups are resolved through complete bound native HSM category metadata; unresolved optional category reads do not affect an explicit AuditEvent declaration.
azure.logging.managed_hsm_audit_destinat.fail_observation: No enabled AuditEvent logging declaration to Storage or Log Analytics was found.
azure.logging.managed_hsm_audit_destinat.missing_observation: Complete native diagnostic configuration and source binding were unavailable or unsupported.
azure.logging.managed_hsm_audit_destinat.pass_observation: Managed HSM declares enabled AuditEvent logging to Storage or Log Analytics. Destination access, delivery and retention were not tested.
azure.logging.managed_hsm_audit_destinat.purpose: Read-only declared configuration; no inherited numbered compliance equivalence.
azure.logging.managed_hsm_audit_destinat.remediation: Review the Managed HSM diagnostic settings and configure an enabled AuditEvent category with the intended Storage or Log Analytics destination. Verify log delivery and storage retention separately.
azure.logging.managed_hsm_audit_destinat.title: Managed HSM declares AuditEvent logging to Storage or Log Analytics
